primitive_definition: Finite input/output channels and positions, shared kernel tap weights, explicit output-position/tap sampling stencil returning optional input position. None is zero padding; repeated positions are permitted. Literal tensor sums are independent of the constructed matrix.

limitation: Mathematical convolution is verified; this does not certify a PyTorch implementation or its parsing of stride, dilation, padding and layout options.
